sharedRules.name: Chaos Boons
sharedRules.description:
At the start of each Battle Round, you may select 1 Chaos Space Marine unit with this special rule. That unit may roll 2D6 on the Chaos Boon table below. That unit gains the listed benefit for the rest of the game. All effects stack if applicable:
2. Warp Surge: The chosen unit gains +1 to its Movement (M) characteristic.
3. Third Eye: The chosen unit gains +1 to its Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic.
4. Precognition: The chosen unit gains +1 to its Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic.
5. Iron Muscles: The chosen unit gains +1 to its Strength (S) characteristic.
6. Loping Grace: The chosen unit gains the Sprint (1) special rule. If they already have the Sprint (x) special rule, increase the value of X by 1.
7. Unnatural Resilience: The chosen unit gains +1 to its Toughness (T) characteristic.
8. Blood Rage: The chosen unit gains the Furious Charge special rule. If the unit already has the Furious Charge special rule, they instead gain +1 to their Attacks (A) characteristic.
9. Mind Fortress: The chosen unit gains the Indomitable Spirit (3+) special rule.
10. Hyper Reflexes: The chosen unit gains +1 to Initiative (I) characteristic.
11. Possession: The chosen unit gains the Daemon Special rule.
12. Champion of Chaos: The chosen unit may select which of the Chaos Boons above they receive.

sharedRules.name: Let the Galaxy Burn
sharedRules.description:
Chaos Space Marine unit with this rule gain +1 to the charge roll in the Charge Phase against a Charge Target for each of the following conditions met (to a max of +4. This is not cumulative with bonuses from the Sprint (x) special rule):
• The Charge Target is Pinned.
• The Charge Target is affected by Blind.
• The Charge Target is affected by Concussive.
• The Charge Target is Falling Back after failing a Panic test.
• The Charge Target has a lower Leadership (LD) characteristic than the charging Chaos Space Marine unit.
• The Charging Chaos Space Marine unit has more models in their unit than the Charge Target. (Bulky (x) units count as X number of models each for determining this bonus).

sharedRules.name: Lord of Damnation
sharedRules.description: You may only field 1 model in your army with this special rule. If your army includes a model with this special rule, they must be your Warlord.

sharedRules.name: 10,000 Years of Hatred
sharedRules.description: A Black Legion army must play 1 additional Battle Round when fighting an Imperium Keyword army. If Abaddon, the Despoiler is in your army, he must be your Warlord.

sharedRules.name: Black Crusaders
sharedRules.description: Black Legion units gain the Hatred (Imperium) special rule. In addition, all Black Legion units which arrive via Deep Strike, gain the Linked special rule on all equipped Shooting weapons they have until the start of their next turn.

sharedRules.name: Piratical Raiders
sharedRules.description: Red Corsairs units gain the Sprint (1) special rule. If they already have the Sprint (x) special rule, increase the value of (x) by 1.

sharedRules.name: Tyrants of Badab
sharedRules.description: A Red Corsair army may not take Rapier Battery or Arquitor Bombards. If Huron Blackheart is in your army, he must be your Warlord.

sharedRules.name: Faith is for fools
sharedRules.description: Creations of Bile armies cannot take units with the Daemon Keyword and may not have any Marks of Chaos. If Fabius Bile is in your army, he must be your Warlord

sharedRules.name: Genomic Perfection
sharedRules.description: All Creations of Bile gain Hammer of Wrath (1). If the unit already has the Hammer of Wrath (X) special rule, it increases the value of X by 1.

sharedRules.name: Heat Blast
sharedRules.description: This unit gains +4” to its Movement (M) characteristic. When this model arrives from Deep Strike, after its final position is determined, measure 6” from the model's hull, then all units take hits equal to the number of models in range. These hits are resolved at Strength 6 AP 5 with Ignores Cover. The hits count as being a Flamer category weapon.

rules.name: Icon of Chaos
rules.description: A unit that includes a model equipped with the Icon of Chaos always counts as scoring 1 additional Wound for the purposes of Combat resolution. Additionally, a unit that arrives on the battlefield via Deep Strike within 12” of a unit with this wargear does not scatter. Finally, when a unit which includes a model with this special rule would conduct a Fall Back Move which would cause it to move off the table, the unit instead stops 1” away from the table edge and automatically rallies in your next Movement Phase.

rules.name: Bike
rules.description: A unit that is equipped with a Bike becomes a Bike type unit. In addition, it gains +1 Toughness (T) Characteristics. A Space marine Bike is equipped with a Linked Boltgun.

rules.name: Chaos Runes
rules.description: A model with a Chaos Runes has a 6+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Wings
rules.description: A unit that is equipped with Wings increases its Movement (M) characteristic to 12”. The model gains the Hammer of Wrath (1), Fly, and Deep strike special rules.

rules.name: Flames of Spite
rules.description: A model with this Warlord trait gains the Arcing (5+) and Deflagrate special rules on all Melee type weapons they are equipped with. If the Warlord weapon already has the Arcing (x) special rule, increase the value of X by 1 to a max of 3+.

rules.name: The Gaze of the Gods
rules.description: The Warlord may roll on the Chaos Boon table during deployment, even if it was not selected to receive a Chaos Boon. This Chaos Boon is in addition to any other Chaos Boons your army receives. If the Warlord was already selected to receive a Chaos Boon, they may roll again with this Warlord Trait and receive a second Boon (Max 2).

rules.name: The Lord of Terror
rules.description: Enemy units within 3” of a model with this Warlord trait halve their Leadership (LD) characteristic

rules.name: Warp Armour
rules.description: Daemonic infused Armour issued to veterans and champions. It provides a 2+ Armour Save.

rules.description:
Once per game, a model with this relic may automatically cast 1 Psychic
Power or Psychic Weapon from the Lore of Tzeentch automatically even if they do not have the Psyker (x) special rule or Tzeentch Keyword.

rules.name: Dimensional Key
rules.description: Friendly units which arrive via Deep Strike wholly within 12” of a model equipped with this wargear do not roll for scatter and automatically arrive with a Perfect Landing.

rules.name: Benediction of Darkness
rules.description: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain the benefits of Light Cover until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Plea of Restoration
rules.description: If this Prayer is answered, the Priest Heals 1 wound. If the Priest has no allocated wounds, you may heal 1 wound on an attached unit. If the attached unit has no allocated wounds but has slain models, you may return 1 model back to the unit with 1 wound remaining.

rules.name: Litany of Despair
rules.description: When this Prayer is performed, all enemy units within 3” of the Priest and any attached unit suffer -1 to their Leadership (LD) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Rite of Iron Boons
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 friendly Vehicle, Aircraft, Automata, or Knight unit within 3” of the unit performing this Rite. The target unit gains +1 to its Ballistic Skill (BS) until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Rite of Corruption
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 enemy Vehicle, Aircraft, Automata, Drone, Battlesuit or Knight unit within 24” of the unit performing this Rite. Select 1 weapon that unit is equipped with. It may only make Snap Shots with that weapon until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Rite of Scrap Code
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 enemy Vehicle, Aircraft, Automata, Drone, Battlesuit or Knight unit within 12” of the unit performing this Rite. That target unit takes D6, Strength 1, AP-, Haywire (5+) Automatic Hits.
